messages:
tyler_release: Heads up — hotpatch for token validation bug. Need expedited approvals to push to prod during the 30m surge window starting now. Patch is v1.3.7-hotpatch-1771240. @maria_eng @raj_sre @olivia_prod

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: release=v1.3.7-hotpatch-1771240, env=prod, strategy=canary(10% -> 50% -> 100%). Runbook: https://internal.redwood/release/1771240 · CI checks: passed · Auto-rollout abort on failed health checks enabled.

maria_eng: quick question — are we pinning model/runtime versions? we should lock the model hash so fallback works if we rollback.

tyler_release: yes — pinning to model@sha256:4a7f... and runtime image redwood/inference:2026-02-15-hotfix. adding to release note.

raj_sre: I'm oncall — can we define rollback criteria before we go? I want clear thresholds.

olivia_prod: change window is 15:00-15:30 PT (short surge). notify CS + infra. release notes snippet: "Fix token parsing that caused 401s on rare refresh flows."

oncall_sre: rollback criteria proposed: 
- error budget: 5xx rate > 1.0% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 300ms above baseline for 5m
- fatal customer impact reported by >1 paid account (CE triage)
If any trigger hits, initiate immediate rollback to v1.3.6 and mark incident. auto-rollback enabled on major health check failures.

jenna_ce: flagged one large customer (acme-inc) who's been seeing the 401. they asked to be notified. I'll standby for verification.

maria_eng: quick smoke checklist I ran on staging: auth flows ✅, streaming sessions ✅, cache TTL unchanged. added the migration guard for older tokens. commands I'll use for pinned tag: ```
git tag -f v1.3.7-hotpatch-1771240
git push --force origin v1.3.7-hotpatch-1771240
```

tyler_release: approvals: @raj_sre (sre), @maria_eng (eng), @olivia_prod (product) — please reply with :thumbsup: if good.

raj_sre: :thumbsup: — I approve given rollback criteria. oncall will monitor.

maria_eng: :thumbsup: ready.

olivia_prod: :thumbsup: green from product. notify marketing for release note microcopy.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary -> 10% (1771240125). Health checks running. Logs: https://logs.redwood/prod/1771240

deploy-bot: Canary passed metrics (5m). Moving to 50% (1771240200).

oncall_sre: watching dashboards. no regression visible, p95 stable.

jenna_ce: pinged acme-inc and told them we'll update once fully rolled.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% traffic (1771240345). Post-deploy smoke recommended.

maria_eng: smoke done on prod quick flows ✅ — token refreshs returning 200. closing the surge window.

tyler_release: thanks team. I'll publish the short release note and close the ticket.
